Stream your boxes' state changes and your agents' status changes, until Ctrl-C.

Usage: termag events [--json]

First the current state, one line per box and per agent session, then one line per change.
--json prints each as a JSON object on its own line; cli/README.md, "Events", lists the fields.

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
